dedupe_keys.name: time series hourly thermal load estimations for 3d city model within lidar data

description: A University of Maribor team publishes hourly thermal-load estimates for its separate 3D city model of Celje, Slovenia. Zenodo lists three public text files under CC BY 4.0: a baseline with TABULA-derived materials and two facade cases using glass-bead or prism retroreflective surfaces. Each file reportedly contains 8,760 hourly values, summing thermal load across all triangles in the city model for one simulated year. The series can benchmark facade-material scenarios or calibrate a reproduction of the modelled urban heat balance. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these three output series. A limitation is that the values are simulation results, not observed energy consumption or building-meter data. The year, weather forcing, load units and occupancy assumptions are not specified on this page. The linked OBJ and MTL geometry must be obtained separately to reproduce the spatial calculation. No text file was downloaded and no hourly value was recalculated.
